hypothesis: R50 supported the frozen two-group-2 lower-capacity readout on attribution-only contexts. If that readout-interface mechanism is real rather than context-specific, the exact frozen two-group-2 readout must outperform full-6 on fresh disjoint contexts at equal or lower resource cost without changing the six-dimensional state former or adaptation budget.
